notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP GET (requests, Chrome desktop User-Agent) succeeded for every page fetched - robots.txt (Disallow only /episerver, /EPiServer, /App_Data, /modules, /search; no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry; Sitemap: https://www.muuto.com/sitemap.xml), homepage-level /products/ page, and every candidate category leaf page. Site server-renders the full mega-menu and every product-tile (Vue 'product-tile' inline-template components with a JSON :data attribute per tile) in the raw HTTP response; no CAPTCHA/DataDome/block encountered. Cross-checked with Playwright (tier b) on 3 sample pages (bookcases, sideboards, rugs) - rendered visible-tile counts (2, 3, 7) matched the HTTP-derived unique-product counts exactly, confirming the HTTP snapshot is not missing client-side filtering/pagination (page has an inert 'Load more' button in the markup but no XHR fired for it and counts are identical pre/post hydration). sitemap.xml (578 URLs) contains only /product/<slug>/ detail pages and content pages, no /products/ category-listing URLs, so the category tree was built entirely from the mega-menu (via the site's own trackHeaderFooter('Header menu','<Column>','<Item>') click-tracking attributes, which gave exact column-group and leaf labels for all ~90 nav links) plus each leaf's own h1/canonical (all matched the requested slug). TREE: top-nav mega-menu columns are Seating, Sofas, Tables, Shelving & Storage, Lighting, Accessories, Outdoor, Product Families, Extras - Furniture/Lighting/Product-Families(collections)/Extras(spare parts) columns skipped entirely (out of scope). QTY: no rendered 'N products' text or JSON total-count field exists anywhere on these listing pages; qty = count of unique product-tile master-id values (each tile carries a distinct Vue :data JSON blob with masterId/productPrimaryName/productSecondaryName - counted via regex parse of the raw HTML, one row per unique masterId), verified against Playwright-rendered DOM tile counts on 3 samples as above. EXCLUDED (Storage): 'Shelving & Storage' > Show all Storage (parent URL /products/storage/ - not recorded, 6 valid subcategories exist per storage.md S34). 'Accessories' > Hangers (7 products: Coil/Attach/Avail coat hooks & racks, Dots ceramic/metal/wood wall hooks) - these are single wall-mounted coat hooks/hangers, not containment/organization storage systems; same treatment as coat-stand/wall-coat-rail exclusions used for other companies in this batch (storage.md S9/S19 boundary - primary purpose is hanging one item, not storage/organization). 'Accessories' > Office (11 products) - not recorded: this is a room-based re-listing, not a distinct storage category - 10 of its 11 products (Sketch Toolbox, Restore Basket, Restore Round Basket, Restore Tray, Story Pinboard, Folded Shelves, Folded Platform Shelf, Compile Bookend, Platform Tray, Arrange Desktop Series) are identical items already reachable via the genuinely Storage-labeled 'Accessories > Storage' node; the only unique item (Reduce Paper Bin, a waste bin) is not storage. Recording it would duplicate/aggregate the same underlying product set under a second label, which is prohibited. 'Outdoor' > Accessories (7 products: cushion, portable lamps x2, outdoor furniture cover, 2 seat pads, 1 rug) - not recorded: mixed-type generic listing (lighting + textile + furniture-cover items together) with no dedicated textile-only or storage-only subpage; pulling a subset out would require estimating/aggregating a sub-count, prohibited. EXCLUDED (Textile): same 'Outdoor > Accessories' mixed node as above. 'Accessories' > Vases, Mirrors, Candle Holders = Decorative Home Accessories, excluded. 'Accessories' > Kitchen (9 products: trays, jugs, carafes, glasses, bowl, trivet) = Kitchen & Dining, excluded (no kitchen textiles found). All of Seating/Tables/Sofas(except Sofa Cushions)/Lighting/Product Families/Extras = Furniture/Lighting/Collections, out of scope, excluded. No bedding, tablecloth/napkin, or bathroom-textile category exists on this site.
